details:
I use notes to keep track of users for moderation purposes as well as to keep notes on friends for personal uses. I use the notes feature often and for important details that I need to be able to access fast and frequently. It is already frustrating that I can't see people's Bios properly anymore due to it being minimized but the notes feature is really important and before there was no issue as if there was no note on the user the note was hidden which was fine but now if I do have a note on a user I have to scroll to view it. From a moderation standpoint with as little moderation options that world and group owners have, this is a BIG deal and is absolutely something that needs to change from the beta. Additionally for moderation purposes I need to be able to see people's represented groups and access them fast but that tiny button that isn't easy to see to show off the represented group will be a NIGHTMARE to deal with moderation wise if it stays as it is now in the beta. The same issue is with the mutuals as it is hard to see the mutual friends and groups tab, it was perfect where it was at the top but even if others don't agree then it should by by the username and larger because that too is important information that people need to see and access quickly. 

I do like the idea of UI being changed but the UI wasn't bad as it was before and was still easily able to be used and user friendly, this UI update takes the user friendliness away and makes use of profiles and other things so much harder with little to no actual improvement in user experience. I would have mentioned other issues but other posts seemed to have covered those well with things like group banners being hard to see, yellow outlines instead of yellow names for friends being hard to see in a crowd, etc. I want the best for VRChat as I've been playing for years and am heavily involved in VRChat's community. I am able to adapt to change and I am still playing on the open beta to really give this update a fair try but these issues are non-negotiable for me from a community moderator standpoint and we already have limited moderation options and tools.
title: (1878) Notes are not visible front and center, mutuals and represented group is also hard to see.
